pages.note: cover: Mass Media/ Mass Communication - 318 Syllabus for CUET(UG), For The Year 2026
topics 1-3; topic 3 has parts A. Advertising and B. Public Relations with items (i)-(v)

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: Understanding Communication
nodes.body: Levels of communication, models of communication

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: Culture and Communication
nodes.body: What is culture? Relationship between culture and mass media; communication in the cultural context; media as a vehicle of cultural transmission; representation and stereotyping in Mass Media.

nodes.label: iii
nodes.title: Communication and Social Change
nodes.body: Social change: meaning; media as a catalyst for social change (with examples of various social movements).

nodes.label: iv
nodes.title: Evolution of the Media
nodes.body: History of Newspapers, Radio & Television in India and New Media

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: Understanding news
nodes.body: Definition, news values, components of news

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: Qualities of a good Journalist.
nodes.body: An understanding of the following: a nose for news, inquisitiveness, language skills, trustworthiness and empathy,

nodes.label: iv
nodes.title: Reporting and Editing techniques
nodes.body: Inverted Pyramid, 5W’s &1 H, Headlines, Copy editing

nodes.label: v
nodes.title: Photo Journalism
nodes.body: Importance of photos, captions, visual depiction, photo essays

nodes.label: vi
nodes.title: Media Laws & Ethical Issues in Journalism
nodes.body: A brief understanding of each of the following with examples: sensationalism, fake news, paid news, plagiarism, advertorials, partisan reporting, and sting operations, defamation, freedom of speech and expression, law and the media

nodes.label: iii
nodes.title: Types of Advertising (Cross promotions, Merchandise, Convert Advertising),

nodes.label: iii
nodes.title: Tools and Steps in PR; PR campaigns

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: Writing for Radio
nodes.body: Characteristics of a Radio Script: conversational language, active voice, simple sentences, avoidance of technical jargons, and capability of creating imageries

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: Radio Recording
nodes.body: Brief understanding of the radio studio and transmission equipment: types of microphones; amplifier, sound mixer, speakers; audio recording.

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: History of Cinema
nodes.body: A brief understanding of the early experiments done by the following: Lumiere Brothers, John Grierson, Robert Flaharty and Dada Saheb Phalke.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: Production process and Cinema Genres
nodes.body: Production process and stages in films and documentary making. Defining genre theory; an understanding of the various types of genres (with suitable examples): action, westerns, comedy, crime, drama, fantasy/sci-fi, historical, animation, romance and musical.

nodes.label: iii
nodes.title: Cinema and Social Change
nodes.body: Parallel Cinema movement in India: Issues depicted and low budget production process (with reference to examples such as Shyam Benegal’s Manthan).

nodes.label: b
nodes.title: Types of social media platforms---social networking, blogging, photo and video sharing

nodes.label: c
nodes.title: Role of social media in a democracy.
nodes.body: Role of social media in creating collective identities with reference to sharing of information; cyber activism (with suitable examples)

nodes.label: d
nodes.title: Cyber Crime.
nodes.body: An understanding of online bullying; stalking; trolling; online frauds.

nodes.label: e
nodes.title: Netiquettes.
nodes.body: Meaning and importance of netiquettes; an understanding of netiquettes such as: identification of oneself; respect for others’ privacy, use of appropriate language and imagery; do not spam.

nodes.label: a
nodes.title: Internet as the meeting point of all the mass media.

nodes.label: c
nodes.title: Mass communication model of a few transmitting to a vast number of receivers.

nodes.label: g
nodes.title: The changed paradigm due to the Internet.

nodes.label: h
nodes.title: Empowering an individual to post data on the Internet

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: Information, message in one medium triggering off activity in the others

nodes.label: j
nodes.title: Many sources of the same information.

nodes.label: k
nodes.title: Distribution of the information between individuals on an unprecedented global scale.

nodes.label: l
nodes.title: Rapidity of opinion generation on a local, national and global scale

nodes.label: m
nodes.title: The socio-political implications of the new information order.
